_: The app's keyboard shortcuts, read by lib/shortcuts.ts: the handler (hooks/use-shortcuts.ts), the Keyboard shortcuts sheet and Settings › Shortcuts all draw this one table. group is the heading an item is under; count makes items 1..count, with {n} in label; what is how a list names it when that differs from label. Keys are written for a Mac (⌘⇧K) and shown as Ctrl+Shift+K elsewhere (lib/platform.ts).
